title: BASELINE — Dietary
description: Meat, fish, fruit, vegetable and tea consumption from the baseline questionnaire.

weekly_times.$comment: Source codes: 0 = do not eat it, 0.1 = less than once a week, 1 – 20 = times / week, 777 = more than 20 times per week. The source gives no 999 for these items. Whole numbers assumed for 1 – 20 because the fractional value 0.1 is listed as its own code (D035).

daily_times.$comment: The source gives no 999 for these items.

meatEater_bl.title: Do you eat meat or fish?

ageVeg_bl.title: How old were you when you last ate any kind of meat or fish (vegetarians only)?
ageVeg_bl.$comment: Source wording: '(vegetarians only)' (R001). The dictionary gives no value for people outside that universe, so no rule is enforced (D036). Whole years assumed for 1 - 70 (D035).

liver_bl.title: In an average WEEK how many times do you eat liver (any type e.g. pigs, chicken, lambs)?

redMeat_bl.title: In an average WEEK how many times do you eat red meat (e.g. beef, lamb, pork, bacon, ham, sausages, burgers)?

poultry_bl.title: In an average WEEK how many times do you eat poultry (e.g. chicken, turkey)?

whiteFish_bl.title: In an average WEEK how many times do you eat White fish (e.g. cod, haddock, tinned tuna)?

oilyFish_bl.title: In an average WEEK how many times do you eat oily fish (canned or fresh e.g. sardines, mackerel, salmon, trout)?

veg_bl.title: Please indicate the times during an average day that you consume vegetables (excluding potatoes)

fruit_bl.title: Please indicate the times during an average day that you consume fruit (whole)

juice_bl.title: Please indicate the times during an average day that you consume fruit juice

smooth_bl.title: Please indicate the times during an average day that you consume fruit smoothies

tea_bl.title: Please indicate the times during an average day that you consume tea
